purpose: Stop technically correct but visually weak gameplay captures from reaching Kevin, the website, social channels or distribution partners.

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Make the creature visibly perform one action inside the same art style as the world. Let the obstacle physically open or regrow over time, keep one short message at most, and frame the creature, obstacle and result as one scene rather than an interface diagram.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Keep the readable choice. Return to the same camera and visibly transform the existing route, ground, light, flora and nearby structures in place so a child can identify what changed without reading a label.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Scale the impossible behaviour up across the playable space, make it affect existing world matter, light or gravity, and give the astronaut and creature a readable reaction. Remove nearly all diagram marks and let the phenomenon explain itself.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Choose one coherent game art direction and rebuild the foreground route in that style. Keep both characters large enough to read, remove the bottom debug-like strip and line, then capture a short journey containing a clear obstacle, creature response and visible payoff.

captureOutcome.meaning: The latest game work adds depth and a more physical alien effect, but the public problem is now visual coherence and scene direction: detailed cutout art, flat map systems, realistic scenery and cartoon actors do not yet feel like one finished game.

nextGate.request: Unify the playable art direction before adding more effects. Build one short showcase route in which the creature is large, performs a visible action, changes existing world art and reaches a payoff without explanatory labels.
